summary: Einride AB, a Swedish autonomous and electric trucking company, reported via Form 6-K that its wholly owned subsidiary Einride MidCo AB acquired a Swedish carrier comprising Ytterhälla Transport AB and Ytterhälla Fastighets AB. The total purchase price was SEK 17,069,056 (~USD 1.79 million), paid 50% in cash and 50% in 133,599 ordinary shares valued at USD 6.670 per share. Sellers also qualify for earn-out consideration of up to SEK 10 million over three years. The acquisition closed on September 1, 2026. Risk factors were updated. Watch for earn-out milestones and integration of the acquired carrier operations.
